links.outcome: Hospitalist LLM use in practice and barriers including policy uncertainty and lack of secure tools
links.effect: 67.1% (170 respondents) ever used an LLM clinically; 48.6% cited uncertainty around institutional policies and 43.1% lack of access to secure applications as barriers.
links.quote: Lack of trust in outputs (49.8%), uncertainty around institutional policies (48.6%), and lack of access to secure applications (43.1%) were cited as the most frequent barriers to using LLMs in practice.

screen.reason: Multicenter survey evaluating the real-world adoption, use cases, and perceived barriers of LLMs by academic hospitalists in clinical practice.
